blockingFindings.title: Equivalent compatibility export is not tested
blockingFindings.rationale: This leaves part of a must requirement without corresponding test coverage.
blockingFindings.issue: R1 requires production source not to add an equivalent compatibility export, but the test only checks the exact symbol buildAcceptanceReviewArtifactFromEvidence is absent. A renamed compatibility wrapper around the deleted behavior could be exported and this test would still pass.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a spec-local assertion that rejects an equivalent one-call compatibility artifact builder export or wrapper contract, not only the deleted export name.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: This leaves part of a must requirement without corresponding test coverage.

blockingFindings.title: Fixture migration coverage can pass on token presence without exercising complete production inputs
blockingFindings.rationale: The static token check could pass without exercising the production behavior required by R2.
blockingFindings.issue: R2 requires repeated fixture assembly to call current production context, artifact, writer, and flow-application exports with complete flow state, mechanical evidence, deferred source evidence, and repair fingerprint inputs. The test only checks that required names appear somewhere in the combined source corpus, so it can pass if the fixture never passes those inputs to the production calls or if different files contain unrelated tokens.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Assert the shared fixture invokes the production exports with the required complete input objects, or execute the fixture path and inspect the produced artifact/state instead of relying on corpus-wide token checks.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The static token check could pass without exercising the production behavior required by R2.

blockingFindings.title: Spec 290 missing-test derivation is not tied to persisted evidence
blockingFindings.rationale: A test could satisfy the current checks while encoding an incorrect independent-construction premise for the required evidence-derived behavior.
blockingFindings.issue: R3 requires missing_tests and missing_required_tests to be derived from persisted evidence. The migration test only checks that related strings and lifecycle functions appear in the corpus, then runs the historical file. It does not verify that the missing-test categories are produced from persisted evidence rather than independently constructed expected outcomes.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add an assertion that the spec 290 regression reads persisted evidence and derives missing_tests and missing_required_tests through the current production verdict/artifact path.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: A test could satisfy the current checks while encoding an incorrect independent-construction premise for the required evidence-derived behavior.
